# Tiled

For the person who lives in tmux and has two to four agents on one task.

The tiles in the active frame lay themselves out as live terminals: one fills the view, two
split it, three or more take a main pane and a stack. Nothing is dragged or sized. Frames are
tabs, and a tab lights up when something in that frame needs you, so another task can call you
without being on screen. The terminals are the app's own, with its bar for status, pop-out and
undock.

It asks for nothing beyond showing your workspace: it cannot start, close or message agents.
